QUOTE: "ServerManager::execute (:153) builds pattern = tool_name + ":" + args_to_pattern(args) and calls permissions_.is_denied. A match returns Error: Permission denied for <tool> and the tool never runs."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says deny is checked in ServerManager::execute, but it also says the allow list is consulted in check_approval and can block calls with "Permission denied" when there's no callback. So it doesn't conclude that the deny list is the only blocker.
